## Release hardening checklist

- [ ] Core regression suites pass
- [ ] UI readability and responsive navigation pass
- [ ] Performance baseline passes
- [ ] Long-save safety passes
- [ ] Linux packaged runtime evidence passes
- [ ] Fresh Windows installer acceptance passes
- [ ] Android debug APK builds and is checksummed
- [ ] Heavy acceptance rerun on final frozen RC commit before promotion
- [ ] Physical-device/accessibility/minimum-spec evidence recorded before 1.0
